name: Blast! – Ruth Childs
description: Ruth Childs presents her solo performance 'Blast!', a study on human expression focusing on the painful, suffering, strange, explosive, and violent body. The performance incorporates musical and spatial concepts that offer a meditative or calming aspect, contrasting with the intensity of the movement.
longDescription:
Ruth Childs performs 'Blast!', a solo piece exploring human expression, particularly the violent and explosive aspects of the body. This work, which premiered in 2022 and received the Prix suisse des arts de la scène, integrates musical and spatial elements to create a juxtaposition or antidote to the intense movements.

The performance takes place at the Auditório do Museu on November 8, 2026, starting at 19:00. Access is granted upon purchasing a Serralves ticket, priced at €15 for residents and €19 for non-residents, valid for entry between November 2 and 8. Tickets are available exclusively at the Museum Reception ticket office, with a 25% discount for purchasing tickets for both days of the event, and free admission for Amigos de Serralves.
